description: This file contains an extension for the OnboardingView, adding a wizardPage() method that builds a SwiftUI view for onboarding setup. It also defines a private SwiftUI View struct OnboardingWizardCardContent that manages the UI states of a wizard process, including error handling, progress, and completion.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardCardContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View managing the display based on the current state of the onboarding wizard, including error states, progress, and completion feedback.

methods.name: wizardPage
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view for the onboarding wizard page, including a header, instructional text, and a card with wizard content. Initiates the wizard process if needed.
